caption: A 15 cm concrete cube: crushed, then pulled 🧱 What was your guess? What should we test next? 👇 #concrete #engineering #physics #science #satisfying #civilengineering #qualitycontrol #3d
description: We test a standard 15 cm concrete cube of class C30/37, the kind used in buildings and bridges, first by crushing it and then by pulling it apart.
Crushed, it holds about 85 tonnes. Eurocode 2 gives this class a cube strength of 37 MPa: 37 MPa x 0.15 m x 0.15 m = 832 kN, about 85 t.
Pulled, the same concrete lets go at about 6.6 tonnes, roughly 13 times less. Its mean tensile strength is only 2.9 MPa.
That is why concrete is reinforced with steel bars: the concrete carries the compression, the steel carries the tension. The animation is a simulated test at the standard's values.
sources_detail: EN 1992-1-1 (Eurocode 2), Table 3.1: C30/37 -> fck = 30 MPa, fck,cube = 37 MPa, fctm = 2.9 MPa
